title: A perfect gift for a movie night (brown Meltie mug)
notes: Replica of the Short with the BROWN variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos; it is also the variant in the original). Hands only, every shot starts from a keyframe built from the product photos + the bible set + bible props. The laptop is a green screen; build.mjs composites original generated stills of a fictional 1980s series (adult characters, no real show footage), cut by the frame edge like the original's laptop. The chocolate bag is plain red with no brand; Sora audio.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, brown
product.description: the BROWN Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy chocolate-brown ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a white interior, 'Chocolate...' in white cursive script with a small white swirl/® mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular brown handle on the right with a small round hole, and a fondue fork with a terracotta-brown handle and long steel tines that clips into the handle

style: Vertical smartphone video filmed at night at a home desk at desk height; warm, cosy, moody colour grade with a deep red wall light; hands have long glossy dark-grey manicured nails. One continuous take: no cuts. Realistic. No on-screen text, no logos.
